content: Root cause: The bug arises from the inability of the `bpf_get_branch_snapshot` function to properly stop the Last Branch Record (LBR) in virtual machines (VMs) running on upstream 5.12+ kernels before too many entries are flushed. This results in inaccurate test results during the hit/waste test, as the LBR cannot be controlled effectively in a hypervisor environment. The patch introduces a check to skip the test in such scenarios until a proper fix for LBR handling in VMs is implemented.
